node.statement: Every row of P has ell^1 norm at most 1 + 2t, hence ||p_Q - p_v||_1 <= 2 + 4t for every row-point fiber Q and ||E||_1 <= 2 + 4t. Therefore any fiber Q confined to the slab 0 <= y_Q <= 1 satisfies |x_Q| * tau = ||x_Q*D||_1 = ||(p_Q - p_v) - y_Q*E||_1 <= (2 + 4t) + (2 + 4t), i.e. |x_Q| <= (4 + 8t)/tau; and any fiber Q with p_Q in conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o} satisfies -A <= x_Q <= 1.
